title: Composa @composa/ui component annotation (contract v1)
description: One machine-readable annotation per component. It is the single source the docs site renders and the enforcement test checks, so a component is 'done' only when a valid, truthful annotation exists. Fields follow the design-system-slots DoD (intent, slots, tokens, states, a11y, enforce); swap_boundary is optional and deprioritized per the owner.

archetype.description: The component's kind. Sets which sections its doc requires, per docs/design-system/section-rubric.md.

intent.description: One line: what this is for.

guidance.description: Bounded editorial prose (<= ~120 words): the non-obvious behavioural / placement / wiring advice the structured fields can't carry. Rendered as the Guidance section.

anatomy.description: The component's visible parts, in reading order. Rendered as a numbered legend (Carbon's anatomy). Each entry is one numbered part.

examples.description: Concrete usage patterns (mainly for composites). Rendered as the Examples section.

story.description: Optional Storybook story id for a live example.

slots.description: Named composition points a host fills. Empty object for a primitive with no slots.

states.description: The visual/interaction states the component renders.

tokens.description: Which design tokens each visual property binds to. No hardcoded values.

enforce.description: Machine-checkable claims the annotation makes about the real component. The enforcement test verifies these against the rendered output / source.

role.description: The ARIA role or native element the component exposes (e.g. 'application', 'complementary', 'tablist', 'button').

ariaRole.description: true when `role` is an ARIA role attribute the rendered tree must carry (checked by render); false/absent when it is a native element name.

tokensOnly.description: true asserts the component source contains no hardcoded hex color (Foundations). The test reads the source and verifies it.
